scope: This is a measured-evidence capsule, not a portable or hermetic compiler distribution.
Exact final04 native compiler/object, tool executables, carrier and parent qualification archives remain separate pinned dependencies.
Generated SSA/assembly/binaries are excluded; independent expected hashes remain in receipts.
Current small diagnostic APIs and runtime hook source are preserved. Restoring absolute paths or relinking on another machine requires renewed output and identity checks.

Full stage/sample re-symbolization needs the exact omitted diagnostic ELF. The archived validated FID/source/clock results remain independently readable; rebuilding an equivalent image is not proof of identical addresses.
Failed attempts remain evidence, not successful qualification. The archive does not rerun compiler or correctness gates.
